topic.label: Marketing
topic.desc: Marketing: strategy and positioning, content and social, search, email and lifecycle, paid media, and measurement.

concepts: Audience segments, positioning, messaging and competitor analysis that set what a campaign says and to whom.
Content planning, social posts and brand-voice review across channels.
Keyword research, site audits and backlink gaps for organic search visibility.
Email campaigns, lifecycle journeys and performance review.
Paid search and paid social campaign planning, creative testing and budget pacing.
Attribution, dashboards and experiments that show which marketing works.
skills: Builds audience segments and personas from customer data and states the evidence behind each segment.
Writes a positioning statement and a message hierarchy per segment, with proof points the company can substantiate.
Compares competitors' positioning, pricing, channels and ads from public data and reports gaps and unverified items.
Plans a channel-by-channel content calendar tied to campaign goals, with owners and dates.
Drafts social posts for each network, picks posting times from engagement data and schedules them.
Reviews drafts against the brand voice and claims rules and returns specific before and after edits.
Finds keywords by volume, difficulty and intent and groups them into topics for content.
Audits a site for crawl, indexing, speed and on-page issues and ranks fixes by expected impact.
Compares backlink profiles with competitors and lists realistic link opportunities.
Plans and drafts an email campaign with subject lines, templates and send schedule, and checks consent and unsubscribe rules before sending.
Designs welcome, onboarding and win-back journeys with triggers, branching and exit conditions.
Reports open, click and conversion results by segment and recommends what to test next.
Plans paid search and paid social campaigns with audiences, budgets, bids and conversion tracking.
Sets up creative variants, runs a test and reports which ads win and by how much.
Tracks spend against plan across ad accounts and flags overspend and underspend early.
Compares attribution models for the same conversions and states how much each channel's credit depends on the model.
Pulls metrics from several marketing sources into one report with definitions and refresh times.
Designs an A/B test with hypothesis, sample size, duration and decision rule before it starts.
